coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Louisiana Paseo
record.summary: Planned 0.7-acre car-free pedestrian paseo along the east wall of Station A (Block 15), connecting Humboldt Street to 23rd Street and opening onto Power Station Park West; designed with Power Station Park by Plural Studio and approved by the Planning Director on June 23, 2022. A Phase 1 open space delivered with Block 15; not built as of the March 2025 annual report.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- a simplified straight-sided approximation of a landscaped pedestrian paseo; the diagram does not show this as a simple rectangle (it likely has planting/path detail not captured here). Positional accuracy matches whatever the adjoining Block 15/7/11 files currently carry (see their own accuracy_caveat) since this polygon is built directly from their vertices.
notes.digitized_from: Potrero Power Station Design for Development, Figure 6.2.3 - Building Height Plan (p.245).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Open space with no subdivided Assessor parcel of its own within the largely unaddressed former power-station site.
notes.regulatory_context: A landscaped pedestrian paseo per the D4D's own Figure 6.2.3 label, connecting Humboldt Street to 23rd Street and opening into Power Station Park.

facts.value: California Barrel Company LLC (project sponsor); now Fifth Space (formerly Associate Capital)
Plural Studio (design review plan sheets dated 7.29.21; CMG names Plural Studio as affiliated landscape architect); D4D concepts by CMG Landscape Architecture

Car-free pedestrian paseo with distinct spaces: paved plaza at 23rd Street for food trucks and small events; seating and possible game tables where it meets Power Station Park; pedestrian passage with seating north to Humboldt Street; 10-foot minimum throughways north-south and east-west (D4D 4.30)
0.7 acres (D4D, DA recital, DEIR); approximately 0.63 acres (Phase 1 application, as 'Louisiana Plaza')
2017-011878PHA-03 (joint Design Review Application with Power Station Park)
Phase 1, delivered with Block 15 (DA originally Phase 4)
Block 15 (Station A) to the west; Blocks 7 and 11 to the east; Station A mid-block passage connects to Georgia Lane
Owned and maintained by the Project Master Association (IMP 9.2)

open_questions: No construction start or completion date found through 2026-09-17; delivery is tied to Block 15 (Station A), whose construction start is not documented in the corpus beyond the 2024 brick stabilization. The added expected-completion milestone therefore uses Phase 1's overall window (2028, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a paseo-specific date.
No cost figure found for the paseo.

The DEIR describes the paseo as 'adjacent to Blocks 6 and 10' (2018 block numbering); the D4D/Design Review place it between Block 15 and Blocks 7/11. Block renumbering between DEIR and D4D not traced.
The Phase 1 application calls it 'Louisiana Plaza' at 0.63 acres versus 0.7 acres elsewhere; whether this is a scope change or a measurement difference is not stated.
Design review submittal date discrepancy ('3.23.20' in annual reports vs March 23, 2021 in the staff memo) as for Power Station Park.
